data.title: 黑歌 · 夏夜祭典的红绳铜铃
data.description: 夏夜神社红灯笼小道上，身穿高开衩旗袍的黑歌牵着你的手快步漫步。她的猫尾巴上系着清脆的红色铜铃缎带，随着步伐叮咚作响，转过头对你吐舌眨眼喵喵叫。
data.location: traditional summer festival lantern path at night
data.action: holding hands walking along red lantern path, ribbon and bell on cat tail, looking back with cheeky playful tongue poke
data.lighting: warm scarlet paper lantern glow creating vibrant festive shadows
data.mood: lively summer festival romance, coquettish mischief, vibrant feline energy
data.promptProse: Walking hand in hand through a festival lantern path in a black cheongsam, Kuroka turns back with a cheeky wink and twin wagging tails.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka walking through summer festival lanterns holding hands playfully.
